title: OpsTracker — Unified Operations, Observability & CI/CD Dashboard
description: Unified SRE dashboard aggregating CI/CD pipeline events, Fastify application logs/traces/metrics, and AWS EC2 infrastructure telemetries (CPU, RAM, Network Bandwidth, Temperature).

panels.title: CI/CD Pipeline — Recent Test & Deployment Events
panels.sql: SELECT timestamp, event_type, status, commit_sha, branch, actor, workflow, target_host FROM cicd_logs ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: CI/CD — Success vs Failure Ratio
panels.sql: SELECT status, count(*) AS count FROM cicd_logs GROUP BY status

panels.title: Application Structured Logs (Fastify + PostgreSQL)
panels.sql: SELECT timestamp, level, method, endpoint, statusCode, durationMs, message, trace_id FROM opstracker_logs ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: HTTP Status Codes Over Time (2xx, 4xx, 5xx)
panels.sql: SELECT histogram(timestamp, '1 minute') AS time, statusCode, count(*) AS requests FROM opstracker_logs GROUP BY time, statusCode ORDER BY time

panels.title: Average Request Latency by Endpoint (ms)
panels.sql: SELECT histogram(timestamp, '1 minute') AS time, endpoint, avg(durationMs) AS avg_duration_ms FROM opstracker_logs GROUP BY time, endpoint ORDER BY time

panels.title: AWS EC2 — CPU Utilization (%)
panels.sql: SELECT histogram(timestamp, '1 minute') AS time, avg(cpu_usage_percent) AS cpu_percent, max(cpu_usage_percent) AS max_cpu_percent FROM ec2_metrics GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: AWS EC2 — Memory Usage (%) and Available MB
panels.sql: SELECT histogram(timestamp, '1 minute') AS time, avg(memory_usage_percent) AS mem_percent, avg(memory_used_mb) AS mem_used_mb, avg(memory_total_mb) AS mem_total_mb FROM ec2_metrics GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: AWS EC2 — Network Bandwidth (TX vs RX kbps)
panels.sql: SELECT histogram(timestamp, '1 minute') AS time, avg(network_tx_kbps) AS tx_kbps, avg(network_rx_kbps) AS rx_kbps FROM ec2_metrics GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: AWS EC2 — Temperature (°C)
panels.sql: SELECT histogram(timestamp, '1 minute') AS time, avg(temperature_celsius) AS temp_celsius, max(temperature_celsius) AS max_temp_celsius FROM ec2_metrics GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
